gaps: Multi-part mystery series on single site (viewers ask 'part 2' on treasure videos)
Scientific forensic analysis of specific artifacts/sites (carbon dating, metallurgy, ground-penetrating radar)
Living descendants/tradition keepers interviews at mystery sites
Comparative: same mystery across multiple sites (e.g. 7 unsolved temple doors)
Pre-Mauryan/pre-historic India with archaeological evidence not speculation
saturated: Standard empire rise/fall narratives (Maurya, Mughal, Gupta, Roman, Byzantine — all ≤2x)
Foreign conqueror biographies (Alexander, Timur — Timur 0x, Alexander 2x)
Dark/violent history without mystery angle (slavery, atrocities — 0.01x)
Non-Indian topics for Indian audience (Great Wall 0.04x)
